This image is a smaller copy of the digitized image provided by the Boston Public Library's wonderul Norman B. Leventhal Map & Education Center, [here](https://collections.leventhalmap.org/search/commonwealth:wd376466z).

I have georeferenced the full image to longtitude-latitude coordinates in the WGS84 datum. This version of the image is available as a GEOTIFF file you can download here for use in a GIS:

- [GEO TIFF file](https://dl.dropbox.com/scl/fi/4uhisdr9iwp1bg9aywfk9/commonwealth_wd376466z_image_primary_wgs84ll.tif?rlkey=iy7erqstmygtnm52kn39zr8ik&st=l169peps&dl=1)
